## 2. Service Offerings

### 2.1 Business IT Support & 24/7 Tech Support
- SLA-backed enterprise business IT support and tech support helpdesk.
- 24/7/365 remote and on-site hardware troubleshooting and workstation provisioning.
- Active Directory / Microsoft Entra ID administration and corporate email migration.
- Rapid emergency on-site dispatch across Gurugram, Delhi, Noida, Jaipur, Bhiwadi, Dharuhera, Rewari, Chandigarh, Neemrana, Behror.

### 2.2 Instant Remote Support Services
- Instant, secure remote screen sharing diagnostics with 256-bit AES encryption.
- Rapid resolution of software crashes, operating system errors (Windows, macOS, Linux), and driver conflicts.
- Remote network and Wi-Fi diagnostics, corporate VPN configuration, and remote worker endpoint assistance.
- Average remote incident triage time under 15 minutes.

### 2.3 IT Backup Support & Disaster Recovery (backupsupport)
- Enterprise-grade IT backup support (backupsupport) protecting critical corporate files, databases, and VM images.
- Automated 3-2-1 backup strategy: Local hot backups + immutable off-site cloud storage.
- Automated daily backup verification, integrity tests, and sandbox disaster simulations.
- Rapid Recovery Time Objective (RTO < 1 hr) and minimal Recovery Point Objective (RPO < 15 mins).
- Backup solutions for Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, PostgreSQL, MySQL, MS SQL, Hyper-V, and VMware.

### 2.4 Managed IT Infrastructure & Systems Monitoring
- Proactive 24/7 server monitoring, CPU/RAM telemetry, and disk failure alerts.
- Cisco switch/router setups, corporate Wi-Fi segmentation, VLAN design, and QoS management.
- Zero-Trust cybersecurity audits, automated patch management, and threat intelligence.

### 2.5 Bespoke Custom Software Development
- Modern Web Apps: Built with React, Next.js, Vite, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS.
- Backend & APIs: Node.js, Express, Python FastAPI, RESTful & GraphQL architecture.
- Database Engineering: PostgreSQL, Supabase, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis caching.
- Cloud Integrations: AWS Lambda, Google Cloud Functions, Azure App Services.
- Mobile Applications: Cross-platform iOS & Android engineering via Flutter and React Native.

### 2.6 Cloud Migration & DevOps Engineering
- Full migration pipelines from on-premises bare metal to AWS, GCP, or Azure.
- Containerization: Docker container builds, Docker Compose, and Kubernetes (K8s) clusters.
- CI/CD Pipelines: GitHub Actions, GitLab CI automated testing, staging, and zero-downtime production releases.
- Security & Compliance: ISO 27001 readiness, HIPAA considerations, and PCI-DSS compliance audits.

### 2.7 Dedicated Developer Staffing & Emergency Manpower
- Pre-vetted, background-checked full-stack developers, frontend specialists, DevOps engineers, and system admins.
- Flexible engagement models: Full-time dedicated squads or part-time staff augmentation.
- Scale up or down with 15-day notice, eliminating traditional recruitment friction.

## 3. SLA & Response Guarantees
- Priority 1 (System Down / Outage): Response in < 30 minutes, dedicated engineer assigned immediately.
- Priority 2 (Severe Degradation): Response in < 2 hours.
- Priority 3 (Feature Request / Minor Issue): Response in < 6 hours.
- 99.9% Uptime guarantee for managed cloud servers.
